description: We are passionate about healthcare innovation 🏥, human space exploration , astronaut health 🧑‍🚀, and technology-driven solutions 💡. Our skills include clinical assessment and health monitoring 🩺, research 🔬, critical thinking and problem-solving 🧩, teamwork 🤝, communication and visual storytelling 🎨, creative thinking, UI/UX and digital design 🖥️, and creating engaging presentations 📊.
